trainingLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Compare worker affinity on and off, reject removal before state externalization, and verify both clients across both workers after migration.
preconditions: Two fixed synthetic clients have instance-local state on worker-a only; affinity initially pins every request there.
Compatible state readers and a modeled atomic migration are assumed, not certified.
No framework, network service, Azure account, credentials or packages are required to open the lesson.
actions: Probe current routing with complete, mismatched or missing observations.
Externalize and verify both records while affinity is on; only complete matching receipts commit.
Remove affinity only after verified externalization.
Restore affinity without reversing externalization or erasing history.
Preview the unsafe off/local counterexample without applying any state change.
Explicitly reset to an untested, local-state, affinity-on run.

faults.mismatch: Wrong revision in the last response or migration receipt, without modifying stored state.
faults.missing: Last response or migration receipt absent, classified unknown rather than successful.

expectedAssertions: Pinned local baseline: 4/4 preserved; removal is still unsupported.
Unsupported removal: failure, safe abort before exposure, unchanged affinity and records.
Unsafe preview: four HTTP 200s, two preserved and two failed required-state checks; not applied.
Complete migration: two matching record receipts, shared verified state, affinity still on.
Shared on/off comparison: 4/4 state checks preserved; off probes reach both workers.
Mismatched or missing migration receipts: no commit and no removal authorization.
Later complete probe cannot erase retained failures, unknowns or counterexamples.
Malformed commands and over-limit steps preserve state and all prior history.
Keyboard controls, explicit error, reset focus and CSP work in an actual isolated browser.
limits: Only local synthetic observations; no live Azure, native B-S033 or source-parent completion.
In-memory, two-client, two-worker, read-only model; no durability, races, concurrent writes, authentication or real cookies.
History lasts for at most 16 steps in this page; reset/reload deliberately clears it.
Guard and migration checks are not user-request continuity probes.
Node 22 test tooling and the approved offline Playwright 1.56.1/signed Edge 156 pairing only; no production Node 24 certification.
No cloud, IaC, identity, deployment, expenditure, package installation or extra Kano unit.
discovery: Standalone portable lesson; no shared catalog or host allowlist is modified.
acceptance: Parent-owned empirical review remains required; publication does not self-award Done credit.
